title: Scroll turntable
description: A glazed studio vessel turns through a cached sequence of thirty-two views on a vermilion plinth.
useCase: Scrub an object sequence by scrolling while retaining direct frame selection.
interaction: Scroll through the object or select an individual view.
reducedMotion: Scrolling and the frame slider select the requested cached view directly; there is no automatic playback.
limitations: The original vessel is drawn on demand and cached across 32 views at display density. It demonstrates indexed-frame playback, not a captured photographic sequence or a 3D model loader.
look: Vivid vermilion backdrop with a softly shaded cream stoneware jug and floor shadow, small dark captions, and a bottom bar with slider and arrows.
motion: Scrolling inside the panel maps progress to one of 32 views so the jug turns stepwise with no easing; the slider and arrows seek frames and sync the scroll.
adapt: The `onScroll` handler maps `scrollTop` across the 800% `.st-track` to `frame` (0–31), and `seek` syncs it back; a sticky `.st-pinned` canvas shows each view, drawn on demand and cached in `frames` (eight kept). Replace the procedural vessel with your own frame images.
